note: Canonical rate card. Site imports this file directly; Python defaults in src/at_utility/config.py are asserted equal by tests/test_rate_card.py. Rates are versioned hypotheses governed by docs/PRICING.md - never edit in place, issue v3.

cache_hit.anchor: Provider cache reads are ~10% of input (USD 0.30-0.50/M, Anthropic/OpenAI 2026) but still charge full output (USD 15-30/M). A withOhm hit replaces the entire call; USD 2/M captures ~10-20% of avoided spend.

cache_miss.anchor: OpenRouter BYOK take is ~5% of inference cost (~USD 0.25/M blended). The miss meter is the visible tax on every uncached call - the true price-resistance point - so it is priced low.

web_fetch.anchor: Tavily PAYG USD 0.008/credit; Firecrawl Hobby USD 0.0032/page with no PAYG option. USD 3/1k undercuts Tavily by 62% and matches Firecrawl entry with the compliance pipe included.
